name: 22911-routerreplay-30ba3b-tp4
hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node. The engine is served directly: no proxy in front of it and no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp4, one tensor-parallel group. No pipeline, data or expert parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 200 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: exactly 1024 prompt and 1024 output tokens with no spread, decoded greedily (`temperature: 0.0`, `ignore_eos: true`), seed 42.
purpose: A long-form drafting assistant generating thousand-token replies from thousand-token prompts for four concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is skipped by the
# reader, so the engine starts without what this file declares.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B

tp-size: 4

enable-return-routed-experts: true

# Keeps a startup autotune search out of the reading.
disable-flashinfer-autotune: true

# Caps the KV pool at ~32x the tokens this workload holds resident. Do not raise or remove it:
# allocation in this serving mode is sized off the pool rather than off the live batch.
max-total-tokens: 262144

random-seed: 42
